relevant_laws.quote: When two vehicles enter an intersection from different highways at approximately the same time, the driver of the vehicle on the left shall yield the right-of-way to the vehicle on the right. Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.

relevant_laws.notes: The cell has a median opening and traffic-signal control. Original road, body-entry, approach, all-entrance device state and turn sources must establish whether both paths enter one statutory intersection from different highways and whether subsection 4 or an exclusion applies. Commanded Off state alone does not prove official status, physical state or legal applicability.
